archetypes.name: The Old Guard
archetypes.blurb: Older and wordier: sings about “our men” and the other team more than about fighting.

archetypes.name: The Classic March
archetypes.blurb: The template: a brisk march that says “fight” and promises victory.

archetypes.name: The Cheer
archetypes.blurb: Built for the student section: rah-rahs and a spelled-out name.

archetypes.name: The Anthem
archetypes.blurb: Few tropes and little trash talk; closer to an alma mater than a battle cry.
